decision: Advisor validates its own answers before returning — retries up to 2 times when confidence < 0.7 or blockers are present, passing the previous answer as context
key_insight: Advisor validates its own answers before returning — retries up to 2 times when confidence < 0.7 or blockers are present, passing the previous answer as context
alternatives_considered: Let the caller decide whether to retry
rejected_reason: First-answer-only produces poor answers when Chronicle evidence is thin; caller retry puts loop logic in every consumer
